nodes.name: constants.ts
nodes.summary: Defines polling intervals, success thresholds, and the empty snapshot default used by the sidebar RAM monitor widget, and re-exports the child-process category enum from types.

nodes.name: formatters.ts
nodes.summary: Small formatting helpers that convert raw memory metrics (megabytes, snapshot totals) into display-ready values for the RAM monitor panel.

nodes.name: formatMegabytes
nodes.summary: Formats a raw megabyte value into a human-readable MB/GB string.

nodes.name: getAppMemoryTotal
nodes.summary: Sums the app's total memory usage from a metrics snapshot.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the sidebar RAM/performance monitor button and its hover panel, showing live process, PTY, webview, GPU, and terminal-buffer memory breakdowns.

nodes.name: SidebarRamMonitorPanel
nodes.summary: Renders the detailed memory/CPU breakdown panel content shown when the monitor button is open, including per-category runtime rows and attribution hints.

nodes.name: SidebarRamMonitorButton
nodes.summary: Exported button component that toggles the RAM monitor dropdown panel via a portal, wiring up the dropdown-engine positioning.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for the RAM monitor feature, including process/child-process metrics, memory snapshot shape, and the child-process category enum.

nodes.name: useRamMonitorMetrics.ts
nodes.summary: Custom hook that polls cheap and expensive runtime memory metrics via Tauri invoke calls on an interval while the monitor panel is open, tracking snapshot and error state.

nodes.name: useRamMonitorMetrics
nodes.summary: Hook implementing the cheap/expensive metric fetch cycles, animation-frame kickoff, and interval scheduling that feed the RAM monitor panel.

nodes.name: SidebarDialogs.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the collection of modal dialogs owned by the workstation sidebar (member filter, cloud share, cloud sync level, move-to-org, rename), driven by controller props.

nodes.name: SidebarDialogs
nodes.summary: Composes the sidebar's dialog components based on passed-in dialog state props.

nodes.name: bottomActions.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook that builds the bottom-right action bar items (group-by cycling, collapse all, mark all read, refresh, external toggle) for the workstation sidebar.

nodes.name: useSidebarBottomRightActions
nodes.summary: Builds the sidebar's bottom-bar action definitions and the group-by mode cycling handler.

nodes.name: cloudSessionsSection.tsx
nodes.summary: Large hook powering the sidebar's cloud/collaboration sessions section: builds threaded session rows, the member-filter menu, viewer avatars, and fork/replay/hide/delete session actions.

nodes.name: readHiddenRemoteSessionIds
nodes.summary: Reads the persisted set of hidden remote (cloud) session ids from localStorage.

nodes.name: useCloudSessionsSection
nodes.summary: Master hook assembling cloud session rows, reply threads, the member filter menu, and session actions (fork, replay, hide, delete) for the cloud sessions sidebar section.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level connector component wiring together sidebar state (sessions, org scope, group-by mode, menu items, dialogs, drag state) into the rendered workstation NavigationSidebar UI.

nodes.name: WorkstationSidebarConnector
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the sidebar's data hooks, Jotai atoms, dialogs, and menu-item builders into the full workstation sidebar UI, including routing and session-refresh wiring.

nodes.name: menuItemWrappers.tsx
nodes.summary: Hooks that wrap raw session/workstation/projects menu items with UI-level rendering behavior (icons, badges, click handlers) for the sidebar menu list.

nodes.name: useRenderSessionMenuItemWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps session menu items with sidebar-specific rendering logic.

nodes.name: useRenderWorkstationMenuItemWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps workstation section menu items with sidebar-specific rendering logic.

nodes.name: useRenderProjectsMenuItemWrapper
nodes.summary: Wraps Projects menu items with sidebar-specific rendering logic.

nodes.name: menuSelection.ts
nodes.summary: Computes which sidebar menu item ids should be considered 'selected' given the current route, active session, and draft state, combining session and section selection resolvers.

nodes.name: resolveSelectedMenuItemIds
nodes.summary: Resolves the set of currently selected sidebar menu item ids for highlighting, delegating to session/draft/section id resolvers.

nodes.name: orgSelectorEntries.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the list of organization selector entries (local + cloud orgs) shown in the sidebar's org switcher, deduping display names and resolving the active org scope id.

nodes.name: resolveProjectOrgScopeId
nodes.summary: Resolves the active org scope id used for filtering projects/sessions.

nodes.name: buildOrgSelectorEntries
nodes.summary: Builds the combined local/cloud org selector entry list with deduped display labels.

nodes.name: sessionEntryActions.ts
nodes.summary: Hook and helper for creating a new chat session from the sidebar, opening either a new tab or navigating within the chat panel depending on context.

nodes.name: openNewChatFromSidebar
nodes.summary: Opens a new chat session, choosing between a new tab and chat-panel navigation based on context.

nodes.name: useSessionEntryActions
nodes.summary: Hook exposing session entry-point creation actions to the sidebar UI.

nodes.name: sessionRowActions.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook that decorates raw session menu items with row-level actions (pin toggle, subagent expand/collapse, context menu, draft delete) for rendering in the sidebar list.

nodes.name: useDecorateSessionRowActions
nodes.summary: Decorates session menu-item rows with pin, subagent expand/collapse, context-menu, and delete actions.

nodes.name: sidebarMemory.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that persists and restores workstation sidebar UI memory (e.g. collapsed sections) across sessions.

nodes.name: useWorkstationSidebarMemory
nodes.summary: Hook managing persisted sidebar UI memory entries such as collapsed section state.

nodes.name: sidebarMenuCollections.ts
nodes.summary: Hooks that assemble pinned menu items, session menu items grouped by section, and chat-panel-TUI terminal sessions for the workstation sidebar.

nodes.name: usePinnedMenuItems
nodes.summary: Builds pinned session/project menu items for the sidebar.

nodes.name: useSessionSidebarMenuItems
nodes.summary: Builds the full session menu item list including drafts, for the sidebar.

nodes.name: useChatPanelTuiSidebarSessions
nodes.summary: Derives chat-panel-TUI terminal session entries for display in the sidebar.

nodes.name: isChatTerminalSidebarItem
nodes.summary: Type guard identifying chat-panel-TUI sidebar menu items.

nodes.name: getChatTerminalTabId
nodes.summary: Extracts the terminal tab id from a chat-panel-TUI sidebar item.
